name: agenthub
description: Monorepo com: - `backend/`: API Node.js (Hapi.js) + Joi, Sequelize (Postgres), JWT auth, e endpoint especial `/fetch-blueprint`. - `frontend/`: React + Redux Toolkit + TanStack Query + Tailwind.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
